findings.issue_text: pkg/expr/reader.go:194–200 — enableSqlExpressions returns false on every path, rejecting all SQL expressions even when FlagSqlExpressions is enabled; return the actual feature-flag value.

pkg/expr/sql/db.go:16–21 — The replacement database returns "not implemented" from both operations used by existing callers, breaking SQL table discovery and frame queries; retain the working backend or implement these operations.

goldens.comment: The enableSqlExpressions function has flawed logic that always returns false, effectively disabling SQL expressions unconditionally:
The DB methods NewInMemoryDB().RunCommands, DB.QueryFramesInto, and DB.TablesList in pkg/expr/sql/db.go return hardcoded 'not implemented' errors after removing the go-duck dependency.
